name: LG-F86-1P
full_description: LG-F86-1P are network wiring faceplates designed for indoor network cabling systems. The faceplates are engineered for easy installation of network modules (Cat5e/Cat6/Cat6A), providing a neat and professional cable outlet solution. With excellent impact resistance, ame retardancy and insulation performance, they are ideal for residential buildings, commercial o ces, hotels, data centers and other network wiring scenarios, ensuring stable signal transmission and long-term reliability.
